TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Transaction to execute the creation of the pricing rules
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: the transaction obtains pricingRuleRequest, logs the received payload and invokes ABKOR001.executePostPricingRules(pricingRuleRequest). Inside the library, it validates effectiveDate.startDate and effectiveDate.endDate; if the end date is before the start date it raises ABKO10000404. If details are present, it sorts them, checks variable and regulated candidate pricing rules for exact duplicates or payment method overlap, and can raise ABKO10010401, ABKO10010402 or ABKO10010415. It then resolves the descriptive value of each detail by entityType and id; if the entity type has no configured lookup or the id has no value, it raises ABKO10010004. 2. Decisions and branches: if details are null or empty, duplicate validation is skipped. If there are no candidate pricing rules, creation continues. If name, precedenceType, progressiveType or status are absent, the DTO applies generated or default values during persistence. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: the transaction gets ABKOR001 through getServiceLibrary and calls executePostPricingRules. The library obtains the request header user, generates audit and pricing rule identifiers, inserts the audit log, inserts the pricing rule, and inserts each pricing rule detail. 4. Errors and follow-up actions: any PricingRuleException raised in the library is converted into addAdviceWithDescription in the same method. After assigning the library result to the output, the transaction evaluates getAdviceList(); when at least one advice is present it sets Severity.EWR. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: the transaction always invokes setPricingrule with the value returned by the library. On success, pricingRuleResponse contains the created pricing rule with the generated id and the resolved detail values. On error, the library returns null and the transaction still attempts to assign that result to pricingRuleResponse.

Accessed Libraries.Description: Validates the pricing rule request, checks duplicate business conflicts, resolves detail values, persists the new pricing rule and its details, and returns the created DTO or an advice on error.
